observations.title: Open the advancement named in chat
observations.player_action: Click an advancement announcement in chat.
observations.outcome: The advancement screen opens at that advancement, exposing its mod's progression tree.
conditions: Upstream requires the mod on both server and client; server chat announcements and configuration affect which entries are clickable.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Presentation/settings alone do not provide an inventory completion signal. Any quest would require a documented native action or explicit manual confirmation.
